Let me test the final variant in memory to confirm zero violations.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_u7e22d82BZQLFaR9kXNK6535","type":"function","function":{"name":"zts_expert_review_patch","arguments":"{"content": "import { run } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call, saga } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): Proof<Response,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"idempotency-key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing idempotency-key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    const outcome = saga([\n      {\n        name: \"reserve\",\n        run: () => call(\"inventory\", { method: \"POST\", path: \"/reserve\" }),\n        compensate: () => call(\"inventory\", { method: \"POST\", path: \"/release\" }),\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"charge\",\n        run: () => call(\"billing\", { method: \"POST\", path: \"/charge\" }),\n        compensate: () => call(\"billing\", { method: \"POST\", path: \"/refund\" }),\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"ship\",\n        run: () => call(\"shipping\", { method: \"POST\", path: \"/ship\" }),\n      },\n    ]);\n    return Response.json(outcome);\n  });\n}\n", "file": "handler.ts"}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":25852,"completion_tokens":952,"total_tokens":26804,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":25216},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":477},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":25216,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":636},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
